title: Barnacle Knight
personality:
A ferryman who carried refugees across the ice the night of the Hollowing and sank his own ship so they could reach shore. The sea remade him: his hull became his armour, his brass diving helmet never comes off, and the ship's compass is set in his chest, with the sea's cyan light glowing between the hull planks.
He doesn't remember his old name, only the children's faces. The teddy bear belonged to the last child he saved.
fantasy: The squad's shield. Holds the line with his aegis, plants his hammer where the fight is, and heals the spot.
silhouette: the frozen prow shield and the long ice-cased oar

card.loop: Frontline tank: block with your aegis, then knock foes into walls with your hammer to stun them.
card.role: Frontline tank: block with your aegis, then knock foes into walls with your hammer to stun them.
card.lmb: Tap to throw the hammer to the cursor and tap again to call it back; hold to spin it, let go to slam forward; let go as it flashes and the slam launches you.
card.rmb: Hold to raise your aegis and block shots from the front. With it up, Shift is a Shield Charge on its own cooldown.
card.e: A green light comes down on your hammer (or on you), then a healing zone round it ticks and ends in a burst.
card.dash: 360 Smash: a short dash that ends in one spinning hit around you; with the aegis up, a Shield Charge (its own {rmb.cooldown}s cooldown).
card.passive: Blocking builds Guard ({tip.passive.n_1} turns your Shield Charge into a Shield Slam); knocking a foe into a wall or another foe stuns it.
card.x: Faultline (level 6): plant, slam, and the ground erupts down a long lane, throwing every foe on it up.

weapons.tower_shield: Tap to throw the hammer to the cursor and tap again to call it back; hold to spin it, let go to slam forward; let go as it flashes and the slam launches you.

passive.name: Guard
passive.desc: Damage your aegis blocks becomes Guard ({resource.crush_stun} per {tip.passive.n_2} blocked, max {resource.max}); at {resource.slam} your Shield Charge ends in a Shield Slam (push {tip.passive.n_3}, stun {tip.passive.n_4}, spends {resource.slam}). Crushed: any knock of yours (Crushing Blow, 360 Smash, Shield Charge, Shield Slam) that drives a foe into a wall or another foe stuns it {resource.crush_stun} ({resource.crush_dmg} damage).

dash.name: 360 Smash
dash.desc: 360 Smash: a hard {dash.whirl}m dash ({tip.dash.secs_1}s) that slides on through one full spin of the hammer around you ({dash.spin_r}m): {dash.whirl_dmg} damage, push {dash.whirl_kb}. With the aegis raised it's a Shield Charge on its own {rmb.cooldown}s cooldown (it spends no dash charge): {dash.charge}m behind the aegis, invulnerable for its length, {dash.charge_dmg} damage and push {dash.charge_kb} (into a wall or a foe: Crushed). Shift while winding up a Crushing Blow: a short plain dash, the blow still charging.

variants.hold: Raise the aegis: a curved gold shield with {rmb.shield.hp} HP that regenerates; it blocks shots from the front and you walk slower. With it up, Shift is the Shield Charge on this slot's {rmb.cooldown}s cooldown.
variants.tap: A tap only raises and lowers the aegis; the Bash is the Shield Charge on Shift.
variants.air: Shield Surf: hold to block from the front while gliding.
variants.full: Guard {tip.rmb.n_1}+: the Shield Charge ends in a Shield Slam, {rmb.slam.dmg} damage, push {rmb.slam.push} and stun {rmb.shield.push_gap} (spends {tip.rmb.n_1}).

e.name: Mending Ground
e.desc: A green light column comes down for {e.delay}s on your hammer (on you with the hammer in hand), then the zone round it heals allies inside {e.tick_heal} every {e.every}s for {e.time}s, following the hammer, and ends in a burst of {e.heal}; if your aegis is raised the burst mends it {e.shield}. A downed teammate inside is a third of the way back up at the burst.

x.name: Faultline
x.desc: Plant and raise the hammer ({x.windup}s, the {tip.x.metres_1}m lane shows to everyone), then slam (planted {x.plant}s more; then you move freely while it runs): the fissure races down the lane, striking each foe on it ({x.cells}, stun {x.strike_stun}), and the ground erupts cell by cell to the far end, throwing each foe up once ({x.dmg}, slowed {x.slow%}% for {x.slow_t}s). A wall or a raised ledge stops it. A glowing scar stays {x.scar_t}s and slows foes on it {x.scar_slow%}%.

rank3.sec: shield HP +{tip.rmb.pct_1%}% in all and it repairs and regenerates faster
rank3.dash: the 360 Smash refunds the Shield Charge when it hits
rank3.kin: Mending Ground's cooldown drops to {e.cooldown_rank3}s and it heals {e.every%}% more in all

rank2.dash: Rank 2: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd2.dash}s per charge; the Shield Charge cooldown {rmb.cooldown}s -> {tip.dash.secs_2}s.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: shield HP +{tip.rmb.pct_1%}% ({tip.rmb.n_3}); regen {rmb.shield.regen} -> {rmb.shield.regen_rank3} per second, back up in {rmb.shield.wait_rank3}s and {rmb.shield.wait}s when broken.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge {cd.dash}s -> {cd3.dash}s; the Shield Charge cooldown {rmb.cooldown}s -> {rmb.shield.lock}s; a 360 Smash that hits refunds it; both dashes go {tip.dash.metres_1}m further.

tells.half: three rune pips over the helm light at {tip.card.n_1} / {tip.card.n_2} / {tip.card.n_3} Guard
tells.full: a gold crest light and a hotter aegis; a {tip.card.secs_1}s flare before a Slam
